Asking About: 
Find the magnitude of each impulse from the given x-t graph for a 0.4 kg mass. 
Concept: 
• Impulse-Momentum Theorem: J = Δp = mΔv 
• Velocity from x-t graph: Slope of x-t graph gives velocity (v = dx/dt) 
Formula: 
J = m|v2 – v1| 
Calculation/Explanation: 
1. Determine velocities from the slope of the x-t graph: 
• Initial velocity (v1): From t = 0 to t = 2, slope = (2 – 0) / (2 – 0) = 1 m/s
• Final velocity (v2): From t = 2 to t = 4, slope = (0 – 2) / (4 – 2) = –1 m/s
2. Change in velocity: 
Δv = v2 – v1 = (– 1) – (1) = – 2m/s 
3. Calculate impulse magnitude: 
|J| = 0.4 × |– 2| = 0.8 N-s 
Final Answer: 
0.8 N-s 
Hence, the correct answer is option (2)
